descFull: Cloud-free revival for Bose SoundTouch speakers: internet radio, Spotify Connect, hardware preset buttons, multiroom. The desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) installs it onto the speaker over your home network; no Bose cloud, no account. Independent open source project, donation funded, MIT license.
